title: First-principles study of AlGaSi2X6 (X = S, Se, Te) monolayers: structural, electronic, transport and photocatalytic properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23120-23128
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00973E, Paper

Thi H. Ho, Tuan V. Vu, A. I. Kartamyshev, Dat D. Vo, Duy Khanh Nguyen, Nguyen N. Hieu
Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were employed to investigate quaternary AlGaSi2X6 (X = S, Se, Te) monolayers as two-dimensional semiconductors for photocatalytic and nanoelectronic applications.
